svg.title: Yug - Origin Story
svg.desc: Animated origin-story banner: typed story lines, frontend and backend skill pills linked by a data packet, a swinging spider, a scrolling skyline and a live commit-pulse graph.

g.text: Bitten by curiosity, not a radioactive spider.
Interfaces that feel fast. Backends that never blink.
Now teaching both to think with AI/ML.
spots bugs before they hit production
“With great power comes great responsibility… and clean commits.”
